title: go_templates
summary: MSUI mirrors the ask-once GameObject template cache faithfully: RequireGameObjectTemplate dedupes per entry with a pending set, ApplyGameObjectQuery decodes the 5875 response (high-bit miss cached), and the LockId property reproduces Benilla's exact type->data[] slot map (DOOR/BUTTON slot 1, CHEST family slot 0, FISHINGHOLE slot 4). Lock.dbc is loaded and drives the use-vs-cast routing: UseGameObject casts a known OPEN_LOCK spell (effect 33 matched against the lock's skill lock-types) or sends CMSG_GAMEOBJ_USE, with the mailbox local-open exception. Tracked-resource matching (PLAYER_TRACK_RESOURCES vs lock type) is live for gathering nodes. The consumers Benilla feeds beyond that are absent.

openItems.text: GO template name/highlight never feeds a world hover: no GameObject mouseover tooltip and no GENERIC (type 5) data[1] highlight-eligibility gate, since GameObjects are not hover-pickable at all
LockType.dbc cursor-stem chain (PickLock/GatherHerbs/Mine cursor over lockable nodes) has no counterpart - there is no contextual world cursor for GameObjects
MO_TRANSPORT (type 15) data0..2 taxiPathId/moveSpeed/accelRate is parsed into Data[] but never consumed - no transport timetable exists
